scripts.gameday:anvil: sh -c 'anvil --port 8545 --silent & tm_anvil_pid=$!; trap "kill $tm_anvil_pid 2>/dev/null || true" EXIT; sleep 2; node scripts/gameday.mjs'
scripts.live-gameday:anvil: sh -c 'anvil --port 8545 --silent & tm_anvil_pid=$!; trap "kill $tm_anvil_pid 2>/dev/null || true" EXIT; sleep 2; node scripts/live-gameday.mjs'
scripts.multiprocess-gameday:anvil: sh -c 'anvil --port 8545 --silent & tm_anvil_pid=$!; trap "kill $tm_anvil_pid 2>/dev/null || true" EXIT; sleep 2; node --no-warnings scripts/multiprocess-gameday.mjs'
